resources.string: While CarPlay is connected, the steering-wheel and centre-console previous/next keys control the iPhone instead of the car\'s stock media app. Calls keep the car\'s original controls. Requires the wheel-key accessibility service.

During spoken CarPlay guidance, volume keys adjust the selected navigation audio stream. Otherwise keys follow the head unit. Requires wheel key accessibility permission. Calls, map zoom and joystick keep priority. Tested locally on a Tang platform-21 head unit; upstream in-car testing is pending. Automatic or media routing is not intercepted.
Allow the wheel key accessibility service in Android settings, or use the existing ADB authorization button.
